mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member (email, password, nickname, species, sex, birth_date, intro, profile_image, address, info_provide_agreement) VALUES (#{member.email}, #{member.password}, #{member.nickname}, #{member.species}, #{member.sex}, #{member.birthDate}, #{member.intro}, #{member.profileImage}, #{member.address}, #{infoProvideAgreement})
mapper.select: SELECT id, email, password, nickname, species, sex, birth_date, intro, profile_image, address, role, status, created_at, info_provide_agreement FROM member WHERE email = #{email}
SELECT id, email, password, nickname, species, sex, birth_date, intro, profile_image, address, role, status, created_at, info_provide_agreement FROM member WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, email, nickname, species, sex, birth_date, intro, profile_image, address, status, role, created_at, info_provide_agreement FROM member ORDER BY id DESC
